channel.description: Updates for iMirror, Android on your Mac.

item.title: iMirror 0.2.1
item.description:
Changed

  • iMirror's bundle identifier is now com.ourappsworld.app.imirror.macos (was dev.imirror.macos). Your trial carries over; if you had activated a licence, enter your key once more under iMirror › Licence… (it re-activates on the same Mac). If in-app update does not offer this version, download the DMG from the releases page.
